Course · Korean for English speakers

Learn Korean, from Hangul to TOPIK 6.

A complete course in standard South Korean for English speakers, from the alphabet to advanced Korean: 80 modules in eight tiers that follow the grammar of TOPIK 1 to 6. The speech levels and honorifics are taught in order, the grammar is explained directly, and every exercise tells you why an answer is right or wrong.

The course, tier by tier

  1. 1 · Hangul and soundsThe alphabet, syllable blocks, final consonants, sound changes, typing Hangul.
  2. 2 · Everyday basicsBoth number systems and counters, polite verbs, the past tense, adjectives.
  3. 3 · Daily lifeRequests and suggestions, negation, joining clauses, the future, shopping.
  4. 4 · Building sentencesThe formal polite style, honorifics, casual speech, noun-modifying clauses.
  5. 5 · Building fluencyNominalisation, conjecture, reported speech, the written style, conditions.
  6. 6 · IntermediateThe passive and causative, the retrospective, concession, hypothesis and regret.
  7. 7 · Upper intermediateBusiness Korean, formal connectives, Sino-Korean words, the news, official Korean.
  8. 8 · AdvancedLiterary grammar, older speech levels, idioms, spoken Korean, dialects, literature.

80 modules in eight tiers that follow TOPIK 1 to 6, plus 13 professional specializations with 117 more modules.

How it teaches

What the course teaches, and how

  • 1

    Hangul first

    The first tier teaches the alphabet, syllable blocks, final consonants (받침) and the sound changes, and you type on the standard two-set keyboard from the start, with an on-screen jamo keyboard.

  • 2

    Speech levels in order

    The polite 해요체 comes first, then the formal 합니다체, honorifics and casual speech in Tier 4, the written 한다체 in Tier 5, and older and literary forms in Tier 8, so you know which ending fits whom.

  • 3

    The grammar taught directly

    Particles, connectives, noun-modifying clauses, reported speech, the passive and causative and the endings of conjecture each have their own modules, explained in plain English with examples.

  • 4

    Feedback that says why

    Every answer gets feedback with a reason and a link to the grammar rule behind it. Every Korean word can be tapped for its meaning, forms, an example and audio.

  • 5

    Pronunciation feedback

    Speaking exercises assess your pronunciation of Korean sentences word by word.

  • 6

    Common traps

    Twelve short sets on the mistakes English speakers make, such as 은/는 against 이/가, 안 against 못, the two number systems, word spacing and Konglish.

Exam preparation

Practice papers for TOPIK

The course has timed practice papers for both tests of the Test of Proficiency in Korean (한국어능력시험), in the paper-based test's task types and with original content. Neither covers the separate speaking test. What the papers cover and how they differ from the real test.

  • TOPIK I, levels 1 and 2: two full-length papers of listening and reading, for learners who have finished Tier 4.
  • TOPIK II, levels 3 to 6: two papers of listening, writing and reading, for learners who have finished Tier 6; the hardest items assume Tier 8.

Questions

Common questions

Do I need to know Hangul before I start?
No. The first tier starts with the vowels and the first consonants, then syllable blocks, final consonants and the sound changes, and you learn to type Hangul as you go.
Which Korean does the course teach?
Standard South Korean, based on the speech of Seoul. Tier 8 also has a module on the dialects and on North Korean usage.
Does the course prepare me for TOPIK?
The tiers follow the grammar of TOPIK 1 to 6, and Premium has two timed practice papers each for TOPIK I and TOPIK II. The papers show the share of points you got, not a TOPIK level, and no course can promise a result.
Is the Korean course really free?
Yes. All 80 modules, the grammar reference, word practice, the placement test and 5 Ask AI questions a day are free. The TOPIK papers, specializations, stories, conversation practice and the other extras are part of Premium.
Can I practise speaking?
The course's speaking exercises give feedback on your pronunciation word by word. With Premium you can also hold typed or spoken conversations with an AI character in 38 situations, and practise pronunciation on sentences you type.
